name: finrunbook
title_zh: 先锁证据链再落笔的金融研究流水线
tagline_zh: 从提问到成稿，每一步都留痕：来源、假设、计算、结论分格存放。适合被审计盯过、或不想返工重查的投研人。
tagline_en: From question to report, every source, calc, and assumption is logged in a structured run file. Built for.
desc_en: Orchestrate evidence-first financial research from a user's question into a finance-industry report or an explicitly requested research memo. Clarify material scope, select and sequence specialist finance skills, build comparable financial analysis, and record sources, evidence, facts, calculations, assumptions, and artifacts in a structured run file. Use for company, sector, market, earnings, val
why_zh: 它把研究过程变成可回放的文件，而非结果堆砌。证据在前、结论在后，审计或复盘时能逐格追溯。
why_en: It makes research replayable, not just presentable. Evidence precedes conclusions, so audits and reviews can trace each claim.
limit_zh: 只覆盖金融研究流程编排，不产出图表或估值模型；需要你已有可调用的财务数据源或专业子技能，否则会停在澄清环节。
limit_en: Orchestrates research flow only; no charts or models built. Needs your own data sources or finance sub-skills, else it halts at scoping.
title_en: Evidence-first financial research orchestrator that logs.
